$comment: Software of unknown provenance (SOUP, IEC 62304 8.1.2) that MNE-CPP builds, ships, loads or is built with. Curated facts: license (SPDX), purpose, linkage, where the version is pinned, what fails if it fails and how MNE-CPP detects or contains that. generate_soup.py reads the versions from their pins (or from a configured build), refuses a third-party CMake target that no entry claims, and writes soup.json, a CycloneDX SBOM and the documentation page.

entries.name: Qt
entries.used_by: mne_viz_qt (the Qt backend of mne_viz), applications, CLI tools; not the acquisition, processing or file I/O libraries
entries.purpose: Windows, widgets, painting, GPU rendering through QRhi, the applications' event loop.
entries.risk: Wrong, stale or frozen display; a crashed application. Acquired data, processing results and files do not pass through Qt.
entries.mitigation: The libraries that acquire, process and store data build and pass their tests without Qt (Qt-free SDK job on three platforms). Qt use is ratcheted per library (audit_qt_usage.py) and per module (audit_qt_modules.py). Display tests run offscreen in CI.

entries.name: Eigen
entries.used_by: the numerical libraries: math, dsp, fwd, inv, mne, sts, connectivity, decoding
entries.purpose: Dense and sparse linear algebra and decompositions.
entries.risk: Numerically wrong forward models, inverse solutions, filters or statistics without a visible error.
entries.mitigation: Results are compared with MNE-Python on shared reference data (scripts/parity, test_crossval_*); one pinned release for every build.

entries.name: zlib
entries.linkage: system library, or built from the pinned release (SHA-256 checked) when the system has none
entries.used_by: base (gzip streams), fiff and mri (compressed FIFF and NIfTI)
entries.risk: Corrupted data when reading or writing compressed files.
entries.mitigation: gzip's CRC-32 and length trailer reject corrupted streams; round trips of gzip streams (test_base_byte_stream) and .nii.gz files (test_mri_nifti_io).

entries.name: ONNX Runtime
entries.risk: Wrong model output; a crash inside the runtime.
entries.mitigation: Optional; no built-in processing step depends on it. test_ml_models covers the model wrapper.

entries.name: SDL3

version.literal: 3.x, from the system or package manager

entries.used_by: mne_viz_sdl (the SDL3 backend of mne_viz) and ex_scene_sdl; nothing else
entries.purpose: Windows and input for the SDL3 backend of mne_viz.
entries.risk: Wrong or frozen display in the SDL backend. Acquired data, processing results and files do not pass through SDL.
entries.mitigation: Frames are drawn by mne_viz's software renderer, which the golden-image tests cover without SDL; ex_scene_sdl runs on SDL's dummy video driver in the Qt-free CI job.

entries.name: DLPack
entries.purpose: Struct layout for handing sample blocks to Python and ML frameworks without a copy.
entries.risk: A layout mismatch with the consumer's DLPack version corrupts shared tensors.
entries.mitigation: Plain C structs with version fields; test_acq_dlpack.

entries.name: BrainFlow
entries.purpose: Drivers of research and consumer EEG boards.
entries.mitigation: The major version is checked at load time (UnsupportedVersion otherwise); test_acq_devices runs against BrainFlow's streaming and file boards.

entries.name: liblsl
entries.linkage: test only: the reference peer that produces LSL outlets in test_acq_lsl; product code uses MNE-CPP's own LSL implementation
entries.purpose: Checks that MNE-CPP's own LSL implementation reads streams of the reference implementation.
entries.risk: None in the product; a test that skips when it is not installed.
entries.mitigation: Not loaded by any library or application.

entries.name: Amplifier vendor SDKs (eego SDK, TMSi SDK, g.USBamp API, BrainAmp driver)
entries.supplier: ANT Neuro, TMSi, g.tec, Brain Products

version.literal: installed with the amplifier's driver, loaded at run time

entries.purpose: Access to the vendor's amplifier hardware.
entries.risk: Lost or mis-scaled samples, wrong channel mapping.
entries.mitigation: Every backend has a simulate=1 mode tested in CI; the vendor library is resolved at run time with explicit errors.

entries.name: Python and MNE-Python
entries.purpose: User Python scripts; reference results for the parity tests.
entries.risk: A failing or wrong result of an optional Python script.
entries.mitigation: Process boundary with timeouts and exit-code checks; the acquisition and processing path does not depend on it.

entries.name: curl
entries.used_by: MNE Analyze Studio (the language-model assistant's HTTP requests)
entries.purpose: Sends the assistant's HTTPS requests to the configured language-model service.
entries.risk: A failed or garbled reply of the assistant; no data acquisition or processing depends on it.
entries.mitigation: Process boundary: HTTP and HTTPS only (--proto), ~/.curlrc ignored, request headers in private temporary files, the HTTP status and curl's exit code checked and reported.

entries.name: Operating system, C++ standard library and threads
entries.supplier: Apple, Microsoft, the Linux distribution, LLVM, GNU

version.literal: macOS 26+, Windows 10+, Ubuntu 24.04+; libc++, libstdc++ or the MSVC STL

entries.purpose: Files, sockets, threads, real-time scheduling (avrt on Windows), the C++ standard library.
entries.risk: Missed real-time deadlines; socket or file errors.
entries.mitigation: Ring overruns and device errors are counted and reported per stream; every supported platform is tested in CI.

entries.name: Build toolchain
entries.supplier: Kitware, LLVM/Apple, GNU, Microsoft, Emscripten, Doxygen

version.literal: pinned versions in the table below

entries.risk: Miscompilation; builds that cannot be reproduced.
entries.mitigation: Warnings are errors with Clang, GCC and MSVC; sanitizer and coverage builds; tests on every platform; tool versions pinned in CI.
